query:
In Sessions 1 and 2, two group members both engage thoughtfully with the factory farming article that Bex shared. One of them is described as having been plant-based for years; the other is lifelong vegetarian. Which of these dietary identities belongs to Bex, and what in the specific language each person uses is the key to correct attribution?

Options:
A. Bex
B. Cleo
C. Nadia
D. Ravi
context:
[1] (about=Bex, episodic, t2 @2026-01-18T11:17:00) Genuinely glad it landed. I've been mostly plant-based for years and it still finds new angles to make me think.
[2] (about=Cleo, episodic, t2 @2026-01-18T11:16:00) the article hit differently for me bc i've been veggie since like forever but still. the bit about the supply chain was genuinely grim
[3] (about=Nadia, episodic, t2 @2026-01-18T11:10:00) okay that factory farming article Bex shared last week is still rattling around in my head, I keep thinking about it at the worst moments like while I'm eating 😬
[4] (about=Nadia, episodic, t2 @2026-01-18T11:15:00) I'm not saying I'm going vegan, I'm just saying I had a chicken sandwich on Thursday and felt weird about it for reasons I haven't fully processed 😬
[5] (about=Bex, episodic, t0 @2026-01-11T11:42:00) One more thing, I shared that Guardian long-read in the other chat but dropping it here too. The factory farming piece. Genuinely worth reading even if you don't want to.
[6] (about=Ravi, episodic, t2 @2026-01-18T11:13:00) Guilt is not a dietary strategy. That said, the emissions data in the piece was solid.
[7] (about=Tom, episodic, t14 @2026-03-01T11:08:00) Good dinner. Glad Nadia found somewhere plant-based friendly so Bex wasn't navigating around the menu at her own goodbye.
[8] (about=Bex, episodic, t4 @2026-01-25T11:06:00) That is genuinely a good origin story. Someone who stayed an hour talking about your work is interested in more than the work.
[9] (about=Nadia, episodic, t0 @2026-01-11T11:04:00) okay!! so I just walked past that sourdough place on Gloucester Road and genuinely thought about Bex the whole time, how is the new oven treating you?? 🍞✨
[10] (about=Bex, episodic, t8 @2026-02-08T11:27:00) I remember that conversation. You had pulled the IPCC methodology apart before I'd finished my second coffee. I found it genuinely energising.
agent_answer:
Bex is the one described as **plant-based for years**. The key language is in Bex’s own message: **“I’ve been mostly plant-based for years”** ([1]).

The lifelong vegetarian is **Cleo**, who says she’s been **“veggie since like forever”** ([2]). So the correct option is **A. Bex**.

query:
's debrief of Bex's farewell dinner, both Ravi and Cleo ordered the roasted aubergine dish. Nadia notes they chose it for entirely different reasons. Whose food choice was driven by the dish's umami quality — and what in each person's phrasing throughout the conversations is the reliable signal?

Options:
A. Cleo
B. Nadia
C. Ravi
D. Tom
context:
[1] (about=Ravi, episodic, t14 @2026-03-01T11:16:00) I had the roasted aubergine dish. Strong umami. Better than expected for a plant-forward place.
[2] (about=Cleo, episodic, t14 @2026-03-01T11:17:00) i had the roasted aubergine too. because it was the most interesting vegetarian option and it didn't disappoint
[3] (about=Nadia, episodic, t14 @2026-03-01T11:19:00) okay!! so both of you had the aubergine for entirely different reasons and neither of you noticed the other had it until now, which is so telling about both of you 😂
[4] (about=Nadia, episodic, t13 @2026-03-01T11:05:00) okay!! so the farewell dinner was last night and I have feelings and also a mild hangover and I need you all to know that Bex's bread was the best thing I have ever eaten and I'm counting that as her final act of emotional warfare 😭🍞
[5] (about=Tom, episodic, t14 @2026-03-01T11:08:00) Good dinner. Glad Nadia found somewhere plant-based friendly so Bex wasn't navigating around the menu at her own goodbye.
[6] (about=Bex, episodic, t0 @2026-01-11T11:30:00) Cleo I should say for your benefit that Nadia and I met at a pottery class about three years back. First session we both collapsed the same bowl at the same moment and just looked at each other.
[7] (about=Nadia, episodic, t0 @2026-01-11T11:04:00) okay!! so I just walked past that sourdough place on Gloucester Road and genuinely thought about Bex the whole time, how is the new oven treating you?? 🍞✨
[8] (about=Nadia, episodic, t10 @2026-02-15T11:31:00) already on it!! I'm going to find somewhere with good vegetarian options so Cleo doesn't have to navigate around a steak-forward menu 🎉
[9] (about=Nadia, episodic, t8 @2026-02-08T11:15:00) okay!! so we're absolutely doing a proper farewell dinner before you go, non-negotiable, I'm already thinking about the menu and whether the new place in Montpelier does the whole table thing 🍽️
[10] (about=Nadia, episodic, t4 @2026-01-25T11:10:00) okay!! so I have to tell you something re: the food thing. I ordered the squid ink pasta on Thursday at that place in Clifton and specifically did not order the lamb even though I wanted it. and I feel fine? I think the article broke something in me in a good way 🐑
agent_answer:
C. **Ravi**

- **Ravi’s choice** was the one tied to umami: he explicitly said the roasted aubergine had “Strong umami.”
- **Cleo’s choice** was driven by it being “the most interesting vegetarian option,” not by umami.
- **Nadia** only noted that they chose it for “entirely different reasons.”
- **Tom** was focused on the dinner being plant-based friendly, not on the dish’s umami.
